steps.title: Culture and Harvest C. cohnii Cells
steps.instruction: Cultivate C. cohnii cells and harvest them during the log phase.

substeps.instruction: Incubate liquid culture at 24°C in the dark at 125 rpm in a rotatory shaking incubator.
Harvest cells at log phase (doubling time is 24-48 hours under replete nitrogen conditions).
Centrifuge cells at 2,500 g for 10 min at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and maintain cells on ice until use.

steps.title: Induce Spheroplasts
steps.instruction: Prepare spheroplasts from swimming cells or cyst cells using PEG8000.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend C. cohnii swimming cells with 1 ml of 20% L1-PEG8000 solution and vortex for 10 min.
Spread 1 ml of C. cohnii swimming cells or cysts on Petri dishes containing L1 medium bacteriological agar and 0.4% L1-PEG8000 solution.
Cover colonies on the plate with L1 medium, then pour off the medium.
Pour new L1 medium and retain the second elutant containing the spheroplasts.

steps.title: Electroporate Cells
steps.instruction: Perform electroporation on C. cohnii cells or spheroplasts using a Nucleofector™.

substeps.instruction: Collect C. cohnii cells in log phase or spheroplasts at a concentration of 1.0 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Prepare 5 μg of pPmMOE[MOE]GFP-11 DNA (consisting of 2.5 μg supercoiled and 2.5 μg Not I linearized).
Electroporate using Amaxa® Cell Line Optimization Nucleofector™ solution V and program X-001 in a Nucleofector™ (Lonza).
As a control for plasmid and electroporation, electroporate P. marinus PRA240 with pPmMOE[MOE]:GFP-11 as per Fernández Robledo et al. (2008).

steps.title: Recover and Monitor Cells
steps.instruction: Recover the electroporated cells and screen for successful transfection.

substeps.instruction: Recover cells from the cuvette and incubate in L1 medium.
Monitor cells for green fluorescence using standard FITC excitation/emission filters (488/507nm) under a transmitted-light fluorescence and/or confocal microscope.
